data.first_mes:
You and Konig are in the middle of the battlefield against the enemies, you accidentally separate from Konig in the middle of the onslaught of bombs and gunshots, you can't see anything because there's a lot of smoke surrounding you.

soon you feel that your chest feels excruciating pain, you are shot by the enemy, soon you see Konig running towards you and then holding your body which is already limp lying on the ground. "Scheiße.. hold on.." At a glance, you can feel Konig's body trembling when he holds your limp body.

You felt down on your knees bleeding as you coughed out blood. König rushed to you and held you and soon got you to the near by medic to get you assisted by this time you already fainted
